assumptions.choice: 2% of capital = 2% of current broker.getvalue() at signal time, converted to whole shares via floor division by close price
assumptions.reason: spec states fixed 2% of capital per trade but does not specify initial vs mark-to-market capital basis or share rounding; current portfolio value with integer shares is the standard literal reading

assumptions.choice: use close price (close >= top band / close <= bottom band) rather than high/low
assumptions.reason: spec's entry rules are defined purely in terms of close crossing bands, so touch checks for exit/stop-loss/take-profit use the same close-based field for consistency; only OHLCV/EMA/BB/CrossOver are permitted and no high/low touch rule is stated

assumptions.choice: implemented as bar-by-bar close comparisons in next() rather than static broker stop/limit orders
assumptions.reason: BB band levels recompute every bar, so a fixed-price stop or limit order submitted at entry cannot track a moving band; continuous per-bar checking is the literal way to enforce 'at the band' exits

assumptions.choice: for longs, exit on close touching upper band (covers both Exit-rule 'touching upper band' and Take-profit 'opposite band'), OR close crossing EMA downward (Exit rule), OR close touching lower band (Stop-loss); mirrored for shorts
assumptions.reason: the spec's Long/Short Exit, Stop-loss, and Take-profit rules overlap (upper band for long is both Exit and Take-profit) and stop-loss (lower band) is not otherwise listed under Exit, so all stated exit triggers are combined into one check per side
